title: Cancellation Terms by Fulfillment Program, Ridgeline Orders & Delivery Terms of Sale
content:
Under every Ridgeline Orders & Delivery fulfillment program the customer may cancel an order before it is ready. Whether the delivery charge is refunded when an order is cancelled before dispatch depends on the program.

| Fulfillment program | Customer may cancel before the order is ready | Delivery charge refunded when the order is cancelled before dispatch |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Ship to Home | Yes | Yes |
| Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store | Yes | No |
| Ridgeline Ship to Store | Yes | No |
| Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery | Yes | Yes |
| Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery | Yes | Yes |
| Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away | Yes | Yes |

### Reading the terms

- The first column is the same for all six programs: cancellation before the order is ready is open to the customer under each of them.
- The second column separates the programs. Ridgeline Ship to Home, Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery, Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery and Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away refund the delivery charge on a cancellation before dispatch; Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store and Ridgeline Ship to Store do not.
